title: Great evening
text: What a fun evening this was with Alex! Walking around Sitges tasting local beverages and tapas offerings! From the heart of the city to breathtaking views of the sea at night, this was a first rate experience!!
author: Navigator674214

title: Culinary Highlight with Easy Cycling
text:
When your group of six books THREE different tours and spends a day and a half with the same guide, you really hope to like him — and Alex did not disappoint. He was incredibly knowledgeable about local culture and culinary history, deeply passionate about his home region, and most importantly, a lot of fun.
From our Sitges Food Walking Tour to Cycling For Vino and finishing with Paella At Our Villa, we enjoyed every moment. We highly recommend booking a tour with Easy Cycling Sitges.
author: R5643RCkerstink
